metadata.title: Sébastien Legros | Senior Full-Stack Developer & Software Engineer
metadata.description: Full-stack developer specialized in React, TypeScript, Go and Node.js. I build robust, maintainable web products with clear product thinking.
metadata.keywords: full-stack developer, React, TypeScript, Go, Node.js, software engineer, web developer, portfolio, Sébastien Legros

hero.name: Sébastien Legros
hero.tagline: I design and ship web products end to end, from the database to the interface. React, Next.js, Node.js, Go, PostgreSQL. Working fully remote from Réunion Island.
hero.lede: From the database to the interface. React, Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL. Fully remote from Réunion Island.

about.title: An approach shaped by clarity, product thinking and execution
about.subtitle: I build web products made to last.
about.body: I enjoy building real-world web applications and business desktop software: back-offices, SaaS platforms, custom C# applications, APIs, payment flows, content systems, integrations and internal tools. My goal is to turn a fuzzy need into something usable, stable and clean to maintain over time.
about.experience_line: 10 years of experience, including 6 in development and 3 as lead.

build.title: Design the right thing
build.description: I start from the actual need, the user flow and the business constraints before committing to implementation details.

scale.title: Build it cleanly
scale.description: Structure, naming, controlled technical debt and codebases the team can pick up without friction matter a lot to me.

ship.title: Ship with confidence
ship.description: CI/CD, Docker, APIs, perceived quality and interface polish: the finish matters as much as the feature itself.

projects.title: Projects built to be useful, not just attractive
projects.subtitle: A selection of products and tools where I worked on architecture, experience and production readiness.

econnect.title: Business CRM Platform
econnect.summary: Design and development of a complete CRM to centralize prospect management, partner workflows, campaign tracking and business automations.
econnect.role: Technical design, data modeling, Go GraphQL APIs, React (Apollo) back-office and third-party service integrations.
econnect.impact: A unified platform foundation to track customer cases, automate communication workflows and support multiple operator configurations.

begaiement.title: Therapeutic Care Platform
begaiement.summary: A specialized care platform combining structured content, patient follow-up and domain-specific therapeutic workflows.
begaiement.role: Full-stack development of the React application, Go REST API, PostgreSQL modeling and overall patient journey structuring.
begaiement.impact: A clearer tool to manage content, therapeutic goals and patient relationship flows in one coherent place.

qrwin.title: Gamification & Campaign Engine
qrwin.summary: Back-office and APIs to orchestrate game mechanics, subscription plans and reward flows around physical activation triggers.
qrwin.role: Go GraphQL API design, React (Apollo) back-office, Stripe subscriptions, virtual wallet system and operator-facing management interfaces.
qrwin.impact: A technical base able to orchestrate campaigns, users, rewards and transactional logic without fragmented tooling.

happiz.title: Mobile Audio Content Platform
happiz.summary: GraphQL backend and editorial back-office for a mobile application delivering structured audio content to end users.
happiz.role: Model design, GraphQL APIs, React (Apollo) back-office and tooling for content publishing and user management.
happiz.impact: A more reliable stack to operate the product, manage content publishing workflows and keep administration straightforward.

actuflux.title: Automated Editorial Pipeline
actuflux.description: An automated video editorial pipeline in Go with a Next.js dashboard, Remotion/FFmpeg video rendering, subtitle generation and content orchestration.
actuflux.short: Editorial videos generated automatically, subtitles included.

prelys.title: Document Management Suite
prelys.description: A Go GraphQL API plus React (Apollo) back-office ecosystem to manage documents, business workflows, structured content and admin tooling.
prelys.short: Documents and business workflows run from a back-office.

cineactu.title: Cinema Alert Platform
cineactu.description: A Next.js cinema-focused application with Supabase, Redis, Stripe payments and alert-driven notification logic.
cineactu.short: Personalised cinema alerts with built-in payments.

mentora.title: Mentora, online English learning platform
mentora.description: Teacher and student spaces, step-by-step session builder, results tracking, course material import and export. Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, NextAuth.
mentora.short: Online English lessons with teacher and student spaces.

preznt.title: Preznt (preznt.fr)
preznt.description: Interactive digital gift platform: passwordless code sign-in, Stripe payments with webhooks, push notifications, 3D scenes. Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Three.js.
preznt.short: Interactive digital gifts, payments and 3D scenes.

leon.title: Guided Podcast Platform
leon.description: React (Apollo, GraphQL) back-office and Go/PostgreSQL backend for a guided podcast mobile app: editorial pipeline, i18n and product logic.
leon.short: Back-office and backend for a guided podcast mobile app.

raoul.title: Payments & KYC Back-Office
raoul.description: React (Apollo, GraphQL) back-office for MangoPay payment management: payment flows, KYC verification, wallets and reconciliations.

psg.title: VIP Campaign Back-Office
psg.description: React back-office, on a REST API, for SMS campaign management and VIP guest information handling under operational constraints.
psg.short: SMS campaigns and VIP guest management.

fidelatoo.title: SQL Loyalty Analytics
fidelatoo.description: SQL query optimization and performance work on a mobile loyalty product with complex data models.
fidelatoo.short: Optimised SQL queries for a loyalty app.

handimobi.title: Accessibility Field App
handimobi.description: Android application to locate wheelchair-accessible places and enrich accessibility field information.
handimobi.short: Wheelchair-accessible places, mapped in the field.

ladar.title: Interest-Based Matching App
ladar.description: Android app matching people through shared interests and geolocation-based proximity.
ladar.short: Matching people by shared interests and proximity.

technologies.title: Expertise
technologies.subtitle: A hybrid profile across web applications, business APIs and desktop software, with a stack built to stay maintainable over time.

web.title: Web
web.description: React/TypeScript and Next.js interfaces, Blazor back-offices in C#, from component to production.

api.title: API & data
api.description: REST and GraphQL APIs in Go, Node.js or ASP.NET Core, on PostgreSQL and SQL Server, clean architecture, solid business logic.

software.title: Software
software.description: Business desktop applications in the .NET ecosystem with productivity-oriented frameworks and rich UI tooling.

experience.title: Background
experience.subtitle: A path from infrastructure to product engineering, then technical leadership.

ird.title: Research Engineer
ird.description: Built web and mobile tools for research data collection and visualization.

region.title: Systems & Networks Administrator
region.description: Infrastructure, security, operations and a strong reliability mindset.

squirrel_dev.title: Web Developer
squirrel_dev.description: Built React interfaces, integrated APIs and grew into product-driven development.

squirrel_lead.title: Lead Full-Stack Developer
squirrel_lead.description: Fully remote: architecture, full-stack development, GraphQL/REST APIs, data modeling and CI/CD pipelines. Designed and built single-handedly a supporting-documents collection module (rules engine, validation workflow, e-mail/SMS notifications, S3 storage, third-party business software API integration).

willow.title: Software Designer & Developer
willow.description: Design and development of web and business applications with C#, MVVM, WPF, WinForms, DevExpress and Blazor, powered by SQL Server, XAF/XPO and Azure DevOps.

neitsa.title: Freelance Developer
neitsa.description: New features, maintenance and production releases for a mortgage broker's CRM; design and redesign of websites for independent professionals. React, Next.js, Go, GraphQL, PostgreSQL.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Need to structure, ship or strengthen a product?
contact.description: I can help on an existing product, a technical foundation that needs to be stabilized, or a new initiative that should start cleanly.
